confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel rates are least certain given seasonality and neighbourhood variation. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the beer anchor (about 3x and 2.5x) because direct price knowledge is weak. The FX value came from a web search summary that cites RBA exchange-rate pages; the RBA page itself was not opened, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Colombian and Andean capital price levels. Medellin is the nearest domestic comparable for food and budget lodging, and Bogota's business-district hotel pricing is treated as a premium over that base.
